text:
Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Striped Leather Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Beige
Colors: Beige
Materials: leather
Your room will be anything but boring with the addition of a textured leather rug. The striped beige tones will bring a modern yet warm and inviting feel to your space. 4' x 6' Flat low-pile is easy to clean and fits well under furniture. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
